_comment: WORKED EXAMPLE OF A REJECTED SUBMISSION — do not merge this record. Synthetic: the company, the award, and the awarding body are all fictional. It exists as the schema contract AND as the regression case for the provenance gate. Run: node scripts/promote-recognition.mjs --in scripts/data/recognition-handoff.rejected-example.json (expect a non-zero exit). It fails twice: on the missing awarderProfile, which is the case under test, and on company resolution, because a fictional company is not in companies.json. See docs/plans/2026-08-21-cohort-recognition-promoter.md.

_awarderProfileNote: Intentionally absent, which is why this record is rejected. A schema-complete submission fills in awarderProfile: { independent, selectionBasis, entryFee, methodologyUrl, vettedBy, vettedOn }. Every one of those must be established by a human who looked at the awarding body — none can be derived from the award itself, and 'unknown' is not a pass. A record that reaches the gate without it fails on the missing profile alone.
